{"consolidated_memory":"## Flapping Flag in platform/featureflags/eval.go — Two Separate Incidents

**Component:** platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)
**File/Test:** platform/featureflags/eval_test.go (covering check)
**Stack:** Go
**Symptom (both occasions):** Flag evaluator exhibits flapping — a flag decision that alternates between calls when the same flag is evaluated for one user repeatedly.

### Incident 1: Non-ASCII Name Records [2026-02-09]

- **Trigger:** Flapping occurred only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root Cause:** Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- **PR:** #4706 (branch: fix/flapping-flag-3)
- **Outcome:** Reclaimed 59 GB of blob storage

### Incident 2: Cold Start Memory Leak [2026-07-26]

- **Trigger:** Flapping occurred only on the first request after a cold start
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR:** #8661 (branch: fix/flapping-flag-7)
- **Outcome:** Memory settled at 575 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

Both incidents were in the same eval.go file but had independent root causes and solutions."}
